Companies hope that drones will help people living in mountain areas. However, drones can be affected by bad weather, so companies need to make sure they can fly safely.

ek2_4.q: Today, many people buy things on the Internet. Do you think online shopping will become more popular in the future?
ek2_4.ja: 将来、ネットショッピングはもっと広まると思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → It is convenient because people can buy things at any time. Also, delivery services are getting faster.
model.no: No. → Many people want to see products before they buy them. They also enjoy shopping with their friends at stores.

ek2_4.q: These days, many people pay without cash. Do you think cash will disappear in the future?
ek2_4.ja: 将来、現金はなくなると思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Paying by smartphone is fast and easy. Stores can also save time because they do not need to count money.
model.no: No. → Some elderly people are not used to cashless payments. Cash is also useful when there is a power outage.

ek2_4.q: Today, robots are used in many places. Do you think more robots will work in stores and restaurants in the future?
ek2_4.ja: 将来、店やレストランで働くロボットは増えると思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Many stores do not have enough workers. Robots can do simple jobs such as carrying food.
model.no: No. → Many customers want to talk with real people. Robots are also too expensive for small stores.

ek2_4.q: In Japan, the number of elderly people is increasing. Do you think the government should do more to help them?
ek2_4.ja: 政府は高齢者をもっと支援すべきだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Many elderly people live alone and need help in their daily lives. The government should build more care facilities.
model.no: No. → Families and local communities can support elderly people. The government also needs money for young people.

ek2_4.q: These days, many people get news from social media. Do you think the information on social media is reliable?
ek2_4.ja: SNSの情報は信頼できると思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → People can get news quickly from people who are actually there. Many news companies also use social media.
model.no: No. → Anyone can post information on social media. Some of it is not true, so people need to be careful.

ek2_4.q: Today, many students take classes online. Do you think online classes are as good as classes at school?
ek2_4.ja: オンライン授業は学校の授業と同じくらい良いと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Students can watch the lessons again and again. They can also study at their own pace.
model.no: No. → It is difficult to ask teachers questions online. Students also need to make friends at school.

ek2_4.q: Many foreign tourists visit Japan. Do you think there should be more signs in foreign languages?
ek2_4.ja: 外国語の案内表示をもっと増やすべきだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Tourists often get lost in big stations. Signs in many languages will help them travel safely.
model.no: No. → Many tourists can use translation apps on their smartphones. Too many signs can be confusing.

ek2_4.q: Some people say that companies should let workers take longer vacations. Do you think this is a good idea?
ek2_4.ja: 会社は社員にもっと長い休暇を取らせるべきだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Workers can relax and come back with more energy. They can also spend more time with their families.
model.no: No. → If many workers take long vacations, the company may not be able to do its work. Customers may have problems.

ek2_4.q: Today, car companies are developing self-driving cars. Do you think self-driving cars will become common in the future?
ek2_4.ja: 将来、自動運転車は広まると思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Self-driving cars can help elderly people who cannot drive. They may also reduce traffic accidents.
model.no: No. → Many people do not trust machines to drive safely. Also, many roads in Japan are narrow and busy.

ek2_4.q: In Japan, many stores are open 24 hours a day. Do you think stores should stay open all night?
ek2_4.ja: お店は夜通し営業するべきだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Some people work at night and need to buy things. Stores are also safe places for people who need help at night.
model.no: No. → It is hard for stores to find workers for the night. Closing at night can also save electricity.

ek2_4.q: Today, many people use AI chat services. Do you think students should be allowed to use AI for their homework?
ek2_4.ja: 生徒が宿題にAIを使うことは認められるべきだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → AI can explain difficult points in an easy way. Students will need to use AI well in their future jobs.
model.no: No. → Students may stop thinking by themselves. Teachers cannot tell how much students really understand.

ek2_4.q: In Japan, the number of children is decreasing. Do you think the government should do more to support families with children?
ek2_4.ja: 政府は子どものいる家庭をもっと支援するべきだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Raising children costs a lot of money. More support would help young couples decide to have children.
model.no: No. → The government already gives a lot of support. It should also spend money on other problems, such as caring for elderly people.

ek2_4.q: Many cities have problems with traffic jams. Do you think cities should charge drivers to enter the city center?
ek2_4.ja: 都市は中心部に入る車から料金を取るべきだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Fewer cars would come into the city, so traffic jams would decrease. The money could be used to improve public transportation.
model.no: No. → It would be unfair to people who need cars for their work. Shops in the city center might also lose customers.

ek2_4.q: These days, some people work as freelancers instead of working for one company. Do you think more people will work as freelancers in the future?
ek2_4.ja: 将来、フリーランスとして働く人は増えると思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → People can choose when and where they work. The internet makes it easy to find work online.
model.no: No. → Freelancers do not have a stable income. Many people prefer the security of working for a company.

ek2_4.q: Some people say that university education should be free for everyone. Do you think this is a good idea?
ek2_4.ja: 大学教育は全員無料にするべきだという意見はよい考えだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Everyone should have the chance to study, even if their family is not rich. Society also benefits when more people get higher education.
model.no: No. → It would cost the government a huge amount of money. Taxes would have to go up for everyone.

ek2_4.q: Today, many people watch videos on the internet instead of TV programs. Do you think TV will become less important in the future?
ek2_4.ja: 将来、テレビの重要性は下がると思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → People can watch videos whenever they like on their smartphones. Young people especially watch less TV these days.
model.no: No. → TV is still important when there is a disaster. Many elderly people also enjoy watching TV every day.

ek2_4.q: Some companies let their workers wear casual clothes. Do you think this is a good idea?
ek2_4.ja: 会社が社員にカジュアルな服装を認めるのはよい考えだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Workers can feel relaxed and work more comfortably. It is also cooler in summer, so companies can save energy.
model.no: No. → Some customers think casual clothes look unprofessional. It can also be difficult for workers to decide what to wear.

ek2_4.q: In some countries, plastic bags are banned. Do you think Japan should ban plastic bags?
ek2_4.ja: 日本はレジ袋を禁止するべきだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Plastic bags often end up in the ocean and harm sea animals. People can easily bring their own bags.
model.no: No. → Plastic bags are useful for many things, such as collecting garbage. Other kinds of bags also use resources to make.

ek2_4.q: Today, many young people do not want to own a car. Do you think owning a car is necessary?
ek2_4.ja: 車を持つことは必要だと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → A car is very useful when people live in the countryside. It is also helpful for families with small children.
model.no: No. → In big cities, trains and buses are very convenient. Owning a car costs a lot of money for parking and gas.

ek2_4.q: Many people work late at night. Do you think companies should stop workers from working overtime?
ek2_4.ja: 会社は社員の残業をやめさせるべきだと思いますか。

model.yes: Yes. → Working long hours can cause health problems. Workers also need time for their families and hobbies.
model.no: No. → Some jobs need extra work when they are very busy. Some workers want to work overtime to earn more money.
